whenToUse: A landing site for an AI writing or text tool, with a scripted demo, use cases, integrations and pricing.
Products that need a dedicated security and data-handling page.
avoidWhen: A general SaaS product without an AI demo — use site-saas-01.
a11y: The typing demo result is announced via aria-live and stops animating under prefers-reduced-motion.
Keep the tone picker reachable by keyboard; the demo region handles key input.
